notes.title: Its released! And Multiplayer
notes.content: The game is finally released and is now playable for everyone. The game now features multiplayer with steam friends.

notes.title: The DEMO is out.
notes.content:
[b]CANNON FIRE DEMO[/b]

The demo of Cannon Fire is out, and you can go and play it right now!
